verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-catalog API that aggregates retailer data for agents and developers, so a merchant onboarding path is a fair question for this kind of product. However, every piece of evidence describes the developer or agent side: search, MCP, SDK, CLI, UCP connection for agents, and affiliate payouts to developers. Nothing documents a merchant enabling a setting, signing an agreement, or publishing an endpoint to accept agent traffic.

support.subject: As a merchant, I have a documented self-serve path to start accepting agent traffic — enable a setting, sign an agreement, or publish an endpoint
